title: Codex reviewer output schema (v2.0+)
description: Structured JSON that codex CLI must return when invoked as Reviewer B via `codex exec --output-schema`. pev-external-reviewer skill parses this into verify.json.reviewers[]. OpenAI structured outputs strict 仕様に従い、 全 properties が required (optional は型に null を含めて表現)、 additionalProperties: false。

verdict.description: Overall reviewer verdict against the AC + rubric

critical_issues.description: Issues that must be fixed before PASS (bugs / security / contract violations)

evidence.description: Quote a diff line or plan.md AC reference

suggested_fix.description: Optional concrete remediation; null when reviewer has no suggested fix

rationale.description: Optional rationale; null when not provided

criterion.description: AC text excerpt or AC id (e.g., AC1)

evidence.description: Diff line / file path / test result reference

model.description: Codex internal model identifier if exposed (e.g., 'gpt-5.3-codex'); null when not exposed

notes.description: Optional free-form reviewer notes (kept short, <= 500 chars); null when none
